entries.title: PostReady: PR #941 — feat: show how far a schedule actually reaches while you pick
entries.description: The schedule post-picker now shows users exactly how far out their schedule extends as they select platforms, giving clear visibility into scheduling coverage before publishing.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #940 — feat: mark videos in the schedule queue and post picker
entries.description: Videos in the schedule queue and post picker are now clearly marked, making it easier to distinguish video vs. image posts.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #939 — fix: stop passing off a bare signature as a written caption
entries.description: Prevents bare caption signatures from being treated as written captions — ensures caption generation always produces real content.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #938 — fix: warn which X account is being connected, and name it after connect
entries.description: Users now see which X (Twitter) account they are connecting before and after the OAuth flow, reducing confusion during account setup.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #937 — Batch images render at medium quality regardless of tier
entries.description: Batch image generation now renders at medium quality for all tiers, ensuring consistent output quality across the board.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #936 — Batch throughput: stop rendering masters inline
entries.description: Batch rendering now skips inline master rendering and no longer crashes mid-wave, improving stability for high-volume carousel generation.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #929 — Land on pack after saving
entries.description: After a user saves a post to a pack, they are now redirected directly to that pack instead of being left to navigate there themselves.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #928 — Onboarding hint foundation + create-first Post Packs hint
entries.description: Shared onboarding hint machinery (#922) plus the first real hint: a contextual nudge on the Post Packs page guiding new users to create their first pack (#923).

entries.title: PostReady: PR #931 — Warn before link goes into caption signature
entries.description: Caption signature is appended to every post on every channel. PR #931 warns users before a booking URL silently turns every X post into a link post (penalised with lower reach and higher cost).

entries.title: PostReady: PR #930 — Fix X quota registry for pay-per-use
entries.description: X retired Free/Basic/Pro tiers on 6 Feb 2026. Pete's account is pay-per-use. PR #930 corrects the quota registry so X shows no artificial monthly cap.
